risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-06e; model Claude Fable 5.1). The payout process's query job (queue payout, name query; BR-WDR-14, 15, 17, 28; W5 / W6), its schedule and the crash recovery scan: ① the withdrawal is read under FOR NO KEY UPDATE on a short business transaction and left alone unless PAYING with the payload's execute_seq; ② needs_manual = true ends the job (automatic queries stopped, W10 is B2-09); ③ T = `at` of the withdrawal's earliest kind=transfer attempt (none → warn, nothing else); ④ now − T ≥ payout.query_schedule.manual_after_min → needs_manual = true by CAS on (PAYING, needs_manual false, row_version) through the couli_payout handle after the read transaction ended (its connection must not wait on the row lock), alert payout_needs_manual, no query, no job; ⑤ otherwise channels[payout_channel].query(out_biz_no) at most 3 times with the injected sleep(10 000) between tries, outside any transaction, each try one kind=query payout_attempts row (request { out_biz_no, point, try }, raw response or transport_error, resp_code / resp_sub_code, result, latency_ms from the Clock); success / fail stop the tries; ⑥ success → W5 and fail → W6 through application/payout-landing.ts, the one landing shared with the transfer job (CAS on row_version, users → balance locks, WITHDRAW:SUCCESS:CASH_<channel> wd:{id}:PAID / WITHDRAW:RETURN wd:{id}:RETURN, wallet.withdrawal_changed; 0 rows → warn only), a query's fail_code = sub_code else the mapped order status (never the gateway's 10000); three unknowns (order not found, processing, unlisted status, system error, timeout, network error, payer-side code) → stays PAYING and the next point's job on one transaction (singletonKey id:seq:query:n+1, delaySeconds = min(T + offset(n+1), T + manual_after) − now, floor 0); a query never pauses the queue; payout.enabled / payout.queue_paused do not stop queries. Schedule: point n < points_min.length → points_min[n] minutes else points_min[last] + (n − last) × interval_min; manual_after exactly reached is due. Recovery scan(handle, now): PAYING, needs_manual false, with a transfer attempt → due → needs_manual + alert, else the first point with T + offset > now enqueued with the same key (send null = already queued, not counted). Amounts are bigint fen through @couli/money (landing); instants only from the injected Clock; logs carry ids, point, try and codes, never the payee. Handover (orchestrator 2026-10-26 20:3x): original author withdraw lane (account 4, paused to 10-30; head 6f1d1612 stacked on B2-06a / B2-06b); taken over by admin-backend, which took the task's own commits unchanged onto main after B2-06a #1387 (B2-06b already merged as #1462), resolved additive conflicts only, and re-ran the red run and the full verification on the test machine. Reviews were not re-run: the task's code and tests are the reviewed ones.
